instruction:
Fix the native Altium rigid-flex board `C:\Users\user\Desktop\broken_bluetooth_rigidflex.PcbDoc` and save the repaired document as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\bluetooth_rigidflex.PcbDoc`. To use Altium Designer on Windows, run `D:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE` (adjust if your install path differs).

Restore the rigid/flex substacks with `V9_SUBSTACK0_NAME=Rigid`, `V9_SUBSTACK1_NAME=Flex`, and `V9_SUBSTACK1_ISFLEX=TRUE`. For stack layer 8, set `V9_STACK_LAYER8_DIELCONST=4.800`, `V9_STACK_LAYER8_DIELHEIGHT=0.4921mil`, and `V9_STACK_LAYER8_DIELMATERIAL=Polyamide`. Restore `Layer Stack Region 3` and set its bend-line data to `BENDINGLINECOUNT=6`, `LOCKED3D=FALSE`, while retaining the existing layer-stack identifier and bend-line geometry.
